name: Loss Of A Child
overview: Scripture acknowledges the profound sorrow experienced in the loss of a child while offering the assurance of God's presence and comfort. Believers are encouraged to trust in the Lord wholeheartedly, even when understanding fails, knowing that He strengthens and upholds those who are brokenhearted. Jesus promises comfort to those who mourn and affirms that it is not God's will for any child to perish, highlighting His tender care and sovereign protection. Through these truths, believers find hope and solace amid their grief.
